# OpenTripPlanner for R

[![R build
status](https://github.com/ropensci/opentripplanner/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/opentripplanner/actions)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/ropensci/opentripplanner/branch/master/graph/badge.svg?token=iLEB77PnMk)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/ropensci/opentripplanner)
[![Project Status: Active – The project has reached a stable, usable
state and is being actively
developed.](https://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](https://www.repostatus.org/#active)
[![](https://badges.ropensci.org/295_status.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/software-review/issues/295)
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.3558311.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3558311)
[![status](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.01926/status.svg)](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.01926)
[![](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/opentripplanner)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=opentripplanner)
[![CRAN_Status_Badge](http://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/opentripplanner)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=opentripplanner)

**opentripplanner** is an R package that provides a simple yet flexible
interface to [OpenTripPlanner (OTP)](https://www.opentripplanner.org/).
OTP is a multimodal trip planning service written in Java. For more
information on what OTP is, see the [prerequisites
vignette](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/articles/prerequisites.html).

**opentripplanner** can be used to interface with a remote instance of
OTP (e.g. a website) or help you set up and manage a local version of
OTP for private use. Basic setup and routing functions are outlined in
the [getting started
vignette](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/articles/opentripplanner.html),
while advanced functionality such as batch routing, isochrones, and
customised setup is described in the [advanced features
vignette](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/articles/advanced_features.html).

## What’s New

The newest version of the package 0.5.0 (Jan 2023) focuses on increased
routing speeds (3-4x faster) and expanding support for OTP v2.2. The new
version also drops legacy support for R 3.6, and so now requires R 4.0
or later. See
[news](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/news/index.html) for
more details.

## Installation

### OpenTripPlanner

To use OpenTripPlanner on your local computer you will need to install
Java 8 and download the latest version of OTP. Instructions on
installing Java and setting up OTP can be found in the [prerequisites
vignette](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/articles/prerequisites.html).

### R Package

To install the stable CRAN version:

``` r

install.packages("opentripplanner") # Install Package
library(opentripplanner)            # Load Package
```

Install the development version using **remotes**:

``` r

# If you do not already have the remotes package
install.packages("remotes")
# Install the package from GitHub
remotes::install_github("ropensci/opentripplanner")
# Load the package
library(opentripplanner)
```

## Usage

The package contains three groups of functions:

Functions for setting up a local instance of OTP:

1.  [`otp_dl_jar()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_dl_jar.md)
    To download the OTP Jar file;
2.  [`otp_dl_demo()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_dl_demo.md)
    To download the demo data for the Isle of Wight;
3.  [`otp_check_java()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_check_java.md)
    To check you have the correct version of Java;
4.  [`otp_build_graph()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_build_graph.md)
    To make a OTP graph from raw data;
5.  [`otp_setup()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_setup.md)
    To start up a local instance of OTP;
6.  [`otp_make_config()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_make_config.md)
    To make a config object;
7.  [`otp_validate_config()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_validate_config.md)
    To validate a config object;
8.  [`otp_write_config()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_write_config.md)
    To save a config object as a json file.

Functions for connecting to a local or remote instance of OTP:

1.  [`otp_connect()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_connect.md)
    To connect to OTP.

Functions for retrieving data from OTP:

1.  [`otp_plan()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_plan.md)
    To get routes from A to B;
2.  [`otp_geocode()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_geocode.md)
    To get the locations of named places e.g. road names (OTP 1.x only);
3.  [`otp_isochrone()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_isochrone.md)
    To get isochrone maps (OTP 1.x only);
4.  [`otp_make_surface()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_make_surface.md)
    To make an analyst surface (OTP 1.x only);
5.  [`otp_surface()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_surface.md)
    To evaluate a analyst surface (OTP 1.x only);
6.  [`otp_traveltime()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_traveltime.md)
    To make a travel time matrix (OTP 1.x only);
7.  [`otp_surface_isochrone()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_surface_isochrone.md)
    To make a raster isochrone map (OTP 1.x only);

Results are returned as [sf
objects](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=sf).

## Acknowledgement

This package was built off the [tutorial by Marcus
Young](https://github.com/marcusyoung/otp-tutorial).

## Contribution

Please note that the `opentripplanner` project is released with a
[Contributor Code of
Conduct](https://github.com/ropensci/opentripplanner/blob/master/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
By contributing to this project, you agree to abide by its terms. Bug
reports and comments are welcome as Github
[Issues](https://github.com/ropensci/opentripplanner/issues) and code
submissions as [Pull
Requests](https://github.com/ropensci/opentripplanner/pulls).

## Citation

Please cite the JOSS paper in publications:

Morgan et al., (2019). OpenTripPlanner for R. Journal of Open Source
Software, 4(44), 1926, <https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.01926>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`json_example_drive`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/json_example_drive.md)
  : Example JSON for driving
- [`json_example_long_drive`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/json_example_long_drive.md)
  : Example JSON for driving long distance
- [`json_example_transit`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/json_example_transit.md)
  : Example JSON for transit
- [`opentripplanner`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/opentripplanner-package.md)
  [`opentripplanner-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/opentripplanner-package.md)
  : OpenTripPlanner of R
- [`otp_build_graph()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_build_graph.md)
  : Build an OTP Graph
- [`otp_check_java()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_check_java.md)
  : Check Java version
- [`otp_check_version()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_check_version.md)
  : Check the what version of OTP the server is running
- [`otp_connect()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_connect.md)
  : Set up and confirm a connection to an OTP instance.
- [`otp_dl_demo()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_dl_demo.md)
  : Download Demo Data
- [`otp_dl_jar()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_dl_jar.md)
  : Download OTP Jar File
- [`otp_geocode()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_geocode.md)
  : Use OTP Geo-coder to find a location
- [`otp_isochrone()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_isochrone.md)
  : Get the Isochrones from a location
- [`otp_make_config()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_make_config.md)
  : Make Config Object
- [`otp_make_surface()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_make_surface.md)
  : Make a Surface
- [`otp_plan()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_plan.md)
  : Get get a route or routes from the OTP
- [`otp_pointset()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_pointset.md)
  : Create a pointset
- [`otp_routing_options()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_routing_options.md)
  : Make routingOptions object
- [`otp_setup()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_setup.md)
  : Set up an OTP instance.
- [`otp_stop()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_stop.md)
  : Stop and OTP Instance
- [`otp_surface()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_surface.md)
  : Evaluate a surface against a pointset
- [`otp_surface_isochrone()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_surface_isochrone.md)
  : Make an isochrone from a surface
- [`otp_traveltime()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_traveltime.md)
  : Get travel times between points
- [`otp_validate_config()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_validate_config.md)
  : Validate Config Object
- [`otp_validate_routing_options()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_validate_routing_options.md)
  : Validate routingOptions object
- [`otp_write_config()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/opentripplanner/reference/otp_write_config.md)
  : Write config object as json file
